name: sku_id
description: Unique Google hardware product SKU code (PK, e.g. SKU-PX11P-256-OBS)

name: product_name
description: Commercial product model name (e.g. Pixel 11 Pro 256GB Obsidian)

name: product_family
description: Hardware category (Pixel Smartphone, Pixel Watch, Audio, Smart Home, Accessories)

name: color_finish
description: Factory colorway and finish (Obsidian, Porcelain, Hazel, Lemongrass)

name: msrp_eur
description: Official retail launch price in Euro (EUR €)

name: warranty_months
description: Standard manufacturer hardware warranty duration in months

name: launch_tier
description: Product launch priority tier (Tier 1 Priority, General Availability)
